planets.name: Kepler-1646 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1646 with a 4.49-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-1646 b was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-1646. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
